# 492. Construct the Rectangle

## Solution 1 (time O(sqrt(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
class Solution(object):
    def constructRectangle(self, area):
        """
        :type area: int
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        cur_w = int(sqrt(area))
        while area % cur_w:
            cur_w -= 1
        return [area / cur_w, cur_w]
```
